info.title: Transition Studio
info.description: Transition Studio API (v1). Internal prototype on SYNTHETIC data only. Analytics are simulated (data_source=mock_random). Not tax or investment advice.

Permanently removes the household (accounts, lots, management events and any transition
in progress). The book file is rewritten without it.
